svg.text: SH3 pure-DR base — detailed verification section
Local x′–z′ geometry; equal spatial scale in the main panel; no chimney or cold finger assembled
A. Exact y′=0 section of retained DR base
B. Port stack detail at z′ = −5.20 cm
Axial x′–z′ cut: one coaxial bore through the five negative-x′ walls
C. Retained shells and plates (cm, local)
Small white marks represent the retained 48-hole plate pattern; not every hole intersects this plane.

• W collimator and W bottom plate
Red hatching in panel A is reference-only, not geometry.
